blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: E-commerce decisions require applying natural-language rules to the available case evidence. We introduce WenSight-Decision-1, a shared model that scores supplied options directly from rules and case information for six operational tasks, with examples spanning six languages. We fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B with reference options as supervision, using the same option scores for training and inference. On 1,440 synthetic operational cases reserved for final evaluation, accuracy rises from 61.60% for Qwen3.5-9B to 92.92% for WenSight-Decision-1 under identical inputs and scoring. Joint fine-tuning improves all six tasks, bringing heterogeneous operational judgments under a common decision interface.
blocks.zh: 电子商务决定要求对现有案例证据适用自然语言规则。 我们引入了WenSight-Decision-1,一种共享模式,通过规则和案例信息直接为6个业务任务提供选项评分,例子涵盖6种语言. 我们微调了Quen3.5-9B,将参考选项作为监督,在培训和推断时使用相同的选项分数。 在为最后评价保留的1 440个合成作业病例中,精确度从Quen3.5-9B的61.60%上升到了WenSight-Decision-1的92.92%。 联合微调改进了所有六项任务,在共同决策界面下作出了多种多样的业务判断。

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Approving a refund, routing a customer request, and reviewing a product claim require different judgments, each governed by operational rules and case evidence. ShARC studies how natural-language rules are interpreted against case information, including when clarification is needed [ 9 ] ; RuleArena documents continuing difficulties in applying complex rules from practical domains [ 16 ] . Such judgments also form part of the retail interactions studied by τ \tau -bench and Mix-Ecom [ 13 , 15 ] . We study six e-commerce tasks arising from the operational needs of our company or its customers. The central problem is to make these judgments with one model while allowing the rules and available answers to vary from case to case.
blocks.zh: 批准退款、确定客户申请的路由和审查产品索赔需要不同的判断,每项判断都受业务规则和案件证据的制约。 ShARC研究如何根据案例信息解释自然语言规则,包括何时需要澄清[9];RuleArena记录了在适用来自实际领域的复杂规则方面继续存在的困难[16]。 这种判断还构成\tau-bench和Mix-Ecom[13,15]所研究的零售互动的一部分. 我们研究了我们公司或其客户的业务需要所产生的六项电子商务任务。 主要问题是,这些判决采用一种模式,同时允许规则和现有答案因案件而异。

blocks.en: WenSight-Decision-1 unifies these tasks in a shared model based on Qwen3.5-9B [ 6 ] . Each input supplies a question, operational rules, case information, and descriptions of the available options. The model scores all options in one forward pass and returns the highest-scoring answer, giving a System 1-style decision path. Supervised fine-tuning uses the same option scores to favor the reference answer. Task-specific criteria and option meanings thus reside in the input, while scoring and supervision follow the same formulation across tasks. WenSight-Decision-1 is the first multi-task System 1-style model developed specifically for decisions governed by e-commerce operational rules.
blocks.zh: WenSight-Decision-1将这些任务统一为基于Quen3.5-9B[6]的共享模式. 每项投入都提供问题、业务规则、案例信息和现有备选方案的说明。 该模型在一次前传中给所有选项打分,并返回得分最高的答案,给出一个System 1风格的决定路径. 被监督的微调使用相同的选项分数来偏好参考答案. 因此,具体任务的标准和选择的含义在于投入,而评分和监督则在任务中遵循同样的表述。 WenSight-Decision-1是第一个专门为电子商务运营规则所制约的决策而开发的多任务系统一式模式.

blocks.en: On 1,440 synthetic operational cases reserved for final evaluation, accuracy rises from 61.60% for the starting Qwen3.5-9B checkpoint to 92.92% for WenSight-Decision-1 under identical inputs and scoring. The overall gain is 31.32 percentage points, and every task improves. Paired development tests examine stability under equivalent wording and correctness when the expected answer changes. The same formulation supports supervised adaptation to other tasks expressed through rules, case information, and a finite set of options.
blocks.zh: 在为最终评估保留的1 440起合成操作个案中,精确度从开始的Quen3.5-9B检查站的61.60%上升到了相同输入和评分下的9292%。 总收益为31.32个百分点,每项任务都有所改进. 在预期答案发生变化时,Paired开发测试以同等措辞和正确性审查稳定性。 同样的提法支持有条不紊地适应通过规则、案例信息和一套有限的备选办法表达的其他任务。

blocks.en: 1.1  Related Work
blocks.zh: 1.1 相关工作

blocks.en: Rule interpretation and policy-conditioned judgments appear in several settings. ShARC emphasizes conversational clarification [ 9 ] , RuleTaker studies what follows from textual facts and rules [ 1 ] , and RuleArena addresses complex regulations and computations [ 16 ] . For safety assessment, SingGuard accepts an active policy and supports direct judgments or extended reasoning [ 10 ] ; ToolGuard compiles company policy into code that checks tool use before execution [ 17 ] . WenSight-Decision-1 learns to select among supplied operational options, including information requests or human review when the rules require them.
blocks.zh: 规则解释和政策性判决在若干场合出现。 ShARC强调对话澄清[9],RuleTaker研究从文字事实和规则[1]中得出的结果,RuleArena处理复杂的条例和计算[16]. 对于安全评估,SingGuard接受积极的政策,支持直接判断或扩展推理[10];TolleGuard将公司政策汇编成检查执行前工具使用的代码[17]. WenSight-Decision-1学习在提供的业务选项中进行选择,包括在规则需要时进行信息请求或人文审查.

blocks.en: A common choice format allows one model to serve multiple tasks. UniMC uses masked option representations and option-prediction supervision [ 12 ] ; GLiClass jointly encodes text and dynamic labels for scoring in one forward pass [ 11 ] . Dyad uses a separate action encoder and learns through environment interaction [ 14 ] . WenSight-Decision-1 uses the next-token scores of letters assigned to options and supervised fine-tuning on reference choices. A similar readout appears in the official Simple Jev technical documentation [ 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 一个共同的选择格式允许一个模型为多个任务服务. UniMC使用遮盖的选项表示和选项预测监督[12];GLiClass联合编码了文本和动态标签,用于在1个前传中打分 [11]. Dyad使用单独的动作编码器,通过环境交互学习[14]. WenSight-Decision-1使用分配给选项的相邻对接的对接字母数,并监督对参考选择的微调. 类似的读取出现在官方的Simple Jev技术文档中[2].

blocks.en: EcomGPT and eCeLLM study multi-task instruction tuning for e-commerce [ 4 , 5 ] , while τ \tau -bench and Mix-Ecom evaluate interactions involving conversations, tools, and domain rules [ 13 , 15 ] . WenSight-Decision-1 addresses the rule-conditioned choices within these settings through a shared model for six operational tasks.
blocks.zh: EcomGPT和eCeLLM研究电子商务的多任务指令调试[4,5],而\tau-bench和Mix-Ecom则评价涉及对话,工具和域规则的相互作用[13,15]. 温视-决定1通过六个业务任务的共享模式,在这些背景下处理有规则条件的选择.

blocks.en: 2  Policy-Conditioned Decision Tasks
blocks.zh: 2项政策性决定任务

blocks.en: The refund review in Figure 1 shows how rules and evidence determine a decision. A USD 60 refund against a refundable balance of USD 80 is allowed when the ownership, permission, currency, and dispute checks are satisfied. Changing only the permission status gives two other outcomes: unknown permission calls for information, while a confirmed lack of permission requires denial. A confirmed dispute freeze calls for human review.
blocks.zh: 图1中的退款审查显示规则和证据如何决定一项决定。 如果所有权、许可、货币和争议核对得到满足,可退还余额为80美元,退还60美元。 仅更改许可状态给出了另外两个结果:未知许可要求信息,而确认的缺乏许可则需要拒绝. 经确认的争议冻结要求进行人文审查.

blocks.en: Confirmed dispute freeze: human review.
blocks.zh: 确认争议冻结:人文审查.

blocks.en: Any confirmed violation: deny.
blocks.zh: 任何确认的违反行为:否认。

blocks.en: Any required fact unknown, including freeze status: request information .
blocks.zh: 任何需要的事实不明,包括冻结状态:要求提供资料。

blocks.en: Otherwise: allow.
blocks.zh: 否则:允许。

blocks.en: Figure 1: A refund-review example and the direct option-scoring path.
blocks.zh: 图1:退款审查实例和直接选项评分路径.

blocks.en: We call choosing one supplied answer according to operational rules and available case information policy-conditioned decision making . A policy is the text specifying the decision criteria. A rule is an individual requirement within it. An input consists of a question q q , policy text r r , case information s s , and a nonempty finite list of options O = ( o 1 , … , o K ) O=(o_{1},\ldots,o_{K}) , where K K is the number of options. The task permits incomplete case information in s s .
blocks.zh: 我们要求根据业务规则和可用案例信息的政策决策选择一个提供的答复。 一项政策是具体规定决定标准的案文。 规则是其中的一项个人要求。 输入包括一个问题q q, 政策文本r r, case information s s, 以及一个非空的有限选项列表 O = (o 1, ..., o K) O = (o_{ 1},\ ldots, o_{K}), K 是选项的数量. 该任务允许在s.s中提供不完整的案件信息。

blocks.en: Each option o j o_{j} has an identifier and a textual description, with j ∈ { 1 , … , K } j\in\{1,\ldots,K\} denoting its position in the presented order. For example, allow identifies the option Approve the proposed refund . Each input specifies its own options and their meanings. For a labeled case, the reference label y ∈ { 1 , … , K } y\in\{1,\ldots,K\} is the position of the annotated option o y o_{y} ; the label and any accompanying annotation are excluded from the model input. The model selects a position y ^ ∈ { 1 , … , K } \hat{y}\in\{1,\ldots,K\} and returns o y ^ o_{\hat{y}} . A prediction is correct when y ^ = y \hat{y}=y , and reordering options updates y y to the annotated option’s new position.
blocks.zh: 每个 o j o j } 都有标识符和文字描述, 其中 j {{ 1, ..., K} j\ in\ 1,\ ldots, K } 在所呈现的顺序中表示其位置 。 例如,允许确定核准拟议退款的选项。 每个输入都指定了自己的选项及其含义. 对于被标注的大小写,参考标签 y {{ 1,., K} y\ in\ 1,\ ldots, K} 是附加说明的选项 o y {} 的位置; 标签和任何随附的注释都被排除在模型输入之外. 模型选择一个位置 y ^ ^ { 1, ..., K }\ hat{ y}\in}1,\ ldots, K\} 。 并返回 o ^ o_{\hat{y} 。 当 y ^ = y\ hat{y} 重新排序选项时, 预测是正确的, 并且将 y 更新到附加说明选项的新位置 。

blocks.en: We use decision for the selected answer and action for a concrete operation such as issuing a refund. The six tasks share this input structure but differ in their judgments and option meanings. Their examples cover English, Chinese, German, Spanish, French, and Japanese.
blocks.zh: 我们利用决定来选择答案和行动来开展具体的行动,例如发放退款。 这6个任务共享这一输入结构,但其判断和选项含义不同. 他们的例子包括英语,中文,德语,西班牙语,法语和日语.

blocks.en: Support routing assigns requests to queues according to responsibilities, priority, and ownership. Product matching checks identity or attribute requirements, with options such as a match, a non-match, and insufficient information. Listing review judges whether a product claim is supported, unsupported, or requires review.
blocks.zh: 支持的路由根据责任,优先权和所有权,将请求分配到队列. 产品匹配检查身份或属性要求,选项包括匹配,非匹配,信息不足等. 列出审查法官是否支持、不支持或需要审查的产品索赔。

blocks.en: Priority classification assigns an urgency level from P0 to P3, with higher numbers indicating greater urgency in our data. Next-step selection chooses whether to answer, look up information, request clarification, or refer for human handling. Action review checks permissions and eligibility for a proposed operation, as in the refund example.
blocks.zh: 优先分类将紧急级别从P0到P3,更多的数字表明我们的数据更加紧迫。 下一步选择选择是回答,查询信息,要求澄清,还是参考人类处理. 如退款例子,行动审查检查一项拟议业务的许可和资格。

blocks.en: 3  Model and Fine-Tuning
blocks.zh: 3 模型和精细图解

blocks.en: 3.1  Scoring and Supervision
blocks.zh: 3.1 计分和监督

blocks.en: We format q q , r r , s s , and O O as a text prompt, assigning each option a distinct single-letter label alongside its description. Let x x denote the tokenized input, θ \theta the model’s full effective parameters, and c j c_{j} the token ID of the letter assigned to o j o_{j} . We encode options with the single-token letters A–Z, supporting 1 ≤ K ≤ 26 1\leq K\leq 26 options and inputs of at most 2,048 tokens.
blocks.zh: 我们将 q q 、 r 、 s 和 O O 格式化为文本提示, 指定每个选项在描述时有一个单独的单字母标签 。 让 xx 表示符号化的输入,\\ tata 模型的全部有效参数,以及 c j\ j} 指定给 o j\ j} 的字母的符号 ID 。 我们用单键字母 A- Z 编码选项, 支持 1 k \\\ 26 1\leq K\leq 26 选项和最多 2 048 个符号的输入 。

For a labeled example ( x , y ) (x,y) , the single-example loss ℒ ⁡ ( θ , x , y ) \mathcal{L}(\theta;x,y) is cross-entropy over the options: ℒ ⁡ ( θ , x , y ) = − log ⁡ p θ ​ ( y ∣ x ) . \mathcal{L}(\theta;x,y)=-\log p_{\theta}(y\mid x). During training, we randomly permute the options and update the reference position and letter mapping together. Task-specific rules and option meanings enter through the input, so all tasks share one readout and loss. The same formulation applies to internal request routing, for example, with routing rules, department descriptions as options, and labeled routing decisions for fine-tuning.

blocks.en: 3.2  Model Adaptation
blocks.zh: 3.2 模型适应

blocks.en: We fine-tune the released, post-trained Qwen3.5-9B checkpoint [ 6 ] on text inputs using low-rank adaptation (LoRA) [ 3 ] . We train approximately 43.28 million adapter parameters in the text modules, or 0.46% of the loaded model’s parameters, while keeping the original weights frozen.
blocks.zh: 微调已发布的,经过后训练的Qwen3.5-9B检查点[6] 使用低等级修改(LORA)的文本输入[3]. 我们在文本模块中培训了大约4,328万个适配器参数,即装入的模型参数的0.46%,同时保持了原有的重量被冻结.

blocks.en: The operational data have three synthetic sources. Initial synthetic examples are AI-authored cases with reference answers determined from the supplied rules and case information; they are used for training, development, and final evaluation. Separately authored synthetic examples are used only for development and final evaluation, with the development portion contributing to checkpoint selection. Harder synthetic examples were designed for more involved rule and evidence judgments, including permission preconditions and claim support. Their preparation included targeted AI semantic review of rule and label consistency. An auxiliary ESCI subset comes from Amazon’s Shopping Queries Dataset [ 7 ] . We retain its published human labels (Exact, Substitute, Complement, and Irrelevant) for search relevance classification in training, development, and final evaluation.
blocks.zh: 操作数据有三个合成来源. 初步的合成实例是大赦国际撰写的案例,参考答复是根据所提供的规则和案例信息确定的;这些案例被用于培训、发展和最后评估。 单独编译的合成实例仅用于开发和最终评价,开发部分有助于检查站的选择. 为更多参与的规则和证据判决,包括许可的先决条件和索赔支持,设计了更硬的合成实例。 他们的编写工作包括对规则和标签一致性进行有针对性的AI语义审查。 一个辅助ESCI子集来自亚马逊购物查询数据集[7]. 我们保留其公布的人类标签(精确、替代、补充和不相关),以便在培训、发展和最后评价中进行搜索相关分类。

blocks.en: The first fine-tuning stage uses initial synthetic examples and the ESCI subset. The second continues from the first-stage adapter, adding harder synthetic examples while replaying earlier training data. Harder examples enter only second-stage training and development. The stages use approximately 4,000 and 6,000 training records, respectively; the second-stage development set contains 1,311 examples. The final checkpoint is selected by development-set performance. Final evaluation counts by source appear in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 第一个微调阶段使用初始合成实例和ESCI子集. 第二作从第一阶段适配器继续,在重放更早的训练数据时会增加更硬化的合成实例. 更难的例子只进入第二阶段的培训和发展。 各个阶段分别使用大约4 000个和6 000个培训记录;第二阶段开发集有1 311个实例。 最终检查点由开发设定的性能选择. 按来源分列的最后评价数见表1。

blocks.en: 4  Evaluation
blocks.zh: 评价

blocks.en: We compare WenSight-Decision-1 with its starting Qwen3.5-9B checkpoint, the reference model , using identical inputs and direct option scoring. This comparison measures the gain from fine-tuning. We fix the checkpoint and scoring configuration before final evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们把WenSight-Decision-1与其开始的Quen3.5-9B检查点(参考模型)进行比较,使用相同的输入和直接选项评分。 这一比较衡量了微调带来的收益。 在最后评估前,我们先修补检查站和评分配置。

blocks.en: The final evaluation contains 1,440 synthetic operational cases and 200 auxiliary ESCI cases, held out from training and model selection. Accuracy is the fraction of cases whose selected semantic option matches the reference answer, aggregated by case; N N denotes the number of cases in a reported group. Behavioral tests use development cases.
blocks.zh: 最后评价包括1,440个合成操作案例和200个辅助ESCI案例,这些案例来自培训和模型选择。 准确性是指所选择的语义选项与参考答案相匹配,按案例汇总的病例比例;N指所报告群体中的案例数量. 行为测试使用开发案例.

blocks.en: 4.1  Decision Performance
blocks.zh: 4.1 决定执行情况

blocks.en: Across the 1,440 operational cases, accuracy rises from 61.60% to 92.92%, a gain of 31.32 percentage points. Table 1 separates the results by task and source.
blocks.zh: 在1 440起业务案件中,准确率从61.60%上升到92.92%,增长31.32%。 表1按任务和来源分列了结果。

blocks.en: Table 1: Final evaluation by task (A) and source (B). Accuracy pairs are Qwen3.5-9B → \rightarrow WenSight-Decision-1 (%). Panel B includes 200 auxiliary ESCI cases in addition to the 1,440 operational cases.
blocks.zh: 表1:按任务(A)和来源(B)分列的最后评价。 精度对称为 Quen3.5-9B →\正弦文相-决定 1 (%). 小组讨论会 B除了1,440起业务案件外,还包括200起辅助ESCI案件.

blocks.en: Fine-tuning improves all six operational tasks, with the largest gain in Priority classification. The gains extend to both synthetic sources, with accuracy reaching 96.08% on the initial examples and 77.08% on the separately authored cases. On the auxiliary ESCI subset, accuracy rises from 43.50% to 51.50%.
blocks.zh: 精细调整完善了全部6个业务任务,优先分类收益最大. 收益扩展到两个合成来源,初步实例的准确度达到96.08%,单独撰写的案件为77.08%。 在辅助ESCI子集上,精度从43.50%上升到51.50%.

blocks.en: 4.2  Behavior and Latency
blocks.zh: 4.2 行为和延迟

blocks.en: Paired tests examine how decisions respond to controlled changes in the input. Following CheckList [ 8 ] , invariance tests preserve the expected semantic answer. Label-changing edits make a different answer correct under the rules. Each pair contains an original input and a transformed version. We compare predictions by option meaning: the prediction flip rate is the fraction of pairs with different semantic predictions. A pair has both predictions correct when each prediction matches its own reference answer; we report the fraction of such pairs.
blocks.zh: Paired测试检查决策如何响应输入中受控的变化. 在"CheckList [8]"之后,偏移测试保留了预期的语义答案. 标签更改编辑使不同的答案在规则下正确. 每对都包含一个原始输入和一个被转换的版本. 我们用选项意义来比较预测:预测倒转率是配对和不同语义预测的分数. 当每个预测都符合自己的参考答案时,一对的预测都是正确的;我们报告这种对数的分数。

blocks.en: Figure 2 illustrates both transformations using the refund example and reports the selected model’s paired development results.
blocks.zh: 图2用退款例子说明转型情况并报告选定模式的配对发展成果。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Paired behavioral tests. (a) Two edits of the refund case in Figure 1 ; all other facts remain fixed. Node labels give the expected answers. (b) Percentages and counts of pairs with both predictions correct, measured on separate development sets under the checkpoint-selection scoring configuration. Semantic predictions change in 7 of 719 paraphrase pairs (0.97%).
blocks.zh: 图 2:行为测试. (a) 图1中的退款案经过两次编辑;所有其他事实保持不变。 节点标签给出预期的答案. (b) 在检查站-选取分数配置下,在单独的开发套件上测量的两种预测正确的百分比和对数。 语义预测在719个句子对中的7个变化(0.97%).

blocks.en: Under the final scoring configuration, WenSight-Decision-1 answers 113 of 120 original development cases correctly. Varying option order, option identifiers, and spacing in option descriptions produces 365 answer-preserving pairs with changed model inputs; one pair has a semantic prediction flip.
blocks.zh: 在最终的分数配置下,WenSight-Decision-1正确回答120个原始开发案例中的113个. 不同选项顺序,选项标识符,以及选项描述中的间隔,产生365个有改变模型输入的保存答案对;一对具有语义预测翻转.

blocks.en: We measure round-trip latency , from request to response, with a resident service on a DGX Spark with one NVIDIA GB10 and a 2,048-token input limit. After warm-up, we send 614 requests from the same 120 cases and their variants serially over fresh local loopback connections. Median (p50) latency is 356.48 ms, and the 95th percentile (p95) is 514.38 ms.
blocks.zh: 我们用DGX Spark上的居民服务测量往返间隔, 热身后,我们发送了614个请求 从相同的120个案例 及其变体 串接在新鲜的本地回路连接。 中位数(p50)为356.48毫秒,第95百分位数(p95)为514.38毫秒.

blocks.en: 5  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: WenSight-Decision-1 brings six rule-conditioned e-commerce tasks into one model that selects among supplied options in a single forward pass. Rules and option meanings enter through the input, while the scoring rule and supervision objective are shared across tasks. Joint fine-tuning raises operational accuracy from 61.60% to 92.92% on the reserved evaluation, with improvements across all six tasks. The shared input format, readout, and training objective support supervised adaptation to other decisions expressed through textual rules, case information, and finite option sets.
blocks.zh: 文视-决定1将6个有规则条件的电子商务任务纳入一个模式,在一个单一的前进通道中从所提供选项中选择。 规则和选项的含义通过输入输入,而评分规则和监督目标则在任务之间共享。 联合微调将业务精度从61.60%提高到92.92%,所有六项任务都有所改善。 共享输入格式、阅读和培训客观支持监督了通过文本规则、案例信息和有限选项集表达的其他决定的适应。
